shipyard.starbridge.title: Rocket assembly dock
shipyard.starbridge.job.recover_cabin: This rocket reached orbit. Use Reboard to enter its cabin.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.cabin_moved: The ship has left its original berth. You cannot board it from this assembler.
shipyard.starbridge.forbidden_at: Remove %s at %s, %s, %s (amber crosshair), then scan again.
shipyard.starbridge.status.invalid_searc: Checking the loaded decks for blocks this server excludes from rockets…
shipyard.starbridge.status.invalid_resca: No excluded block found on the loaded decks. Load the whole dock and scan again.
shipyard.starbridge.pad_gap_at: Fill the marked launchpad cell at %s, %s, %s.
shipyard.starbridge.status.pad: Build a continuous pad, place the tower on its edge and face the assembler outward.
shipyard.starbridge.status.unscanned: Scan after placing the hull, flight core, guidance computer, seat, engines and tanks.
shipyard.starbridge.status.success: The original scan passed. Check the layers and assemble.
shipyard.starbridge.status.finished: Construction finished. Fuel the original rocket and board.
shipyard.starbridge.status.noguidance: Install an Advanced Rocketry guidance computer on the ship.
shipyard.starbridge.status.noengines: Add engines until thrust exceeds the ship's weight.
shipyard.starbridge.status.nofuel: Fit more tanks. The gauge shows the capacity needed to ascend.
shipyard.starbridge.status.noseat: Fit a seat for the pilot.
shipyard.starbridge.status.invalidblock: An installed block cannot fly. Check the hull layers.
shipyard.starbridge.status.unavailable: The upstream machine could not be read.
shipyard.starbridge.status.empty: Place your ship above the launchpad.
shipyard.starbridge.job.build: The original assembler is working. Keep its power connected.
shipyard.starbridge.job.cutting: Packing the current cargo and machines.
shipyard.starbridge.job.packed: Rocket ready. Refuel with propellant in hand, then board with an empty hand.
shipyard.starbridge.job.ascent: Ascending on the original rocket. Stay in the seat.
shipyard.starbridge.job.transfer: Opening the cabin and checking crew positions.
shipyard.starbridge.job.inspect: The stored ship and live hull disagree. The saved manifest has been retained.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.pad: Complete the pad and its edge tower. Consult the structure diagram.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.too_small: Raise the tower or enlarge the pad so the original assembler can start its timer.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.scan_first: Scan this ship with the original machine first.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.owner: Fit exactly one flight core, owned by the builder.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.core: Place your flight core inside the scanned hull.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.size: The cabin data exceeds the supported size.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.approach: Move closer to the rocket and dismount other vehicles.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.hand: Use an empty main hand to board the rocket.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.seat: Fit an available Advanced Rocketry seat. The owner must board to launch.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.fuel: Fill the original rocket with propellant before launch.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.propellant: Hold a filled container of a propellant the original rocket accepts.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.full: The rocket's fuel tank is full.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.navigation: The original guidance computer rejected launch. Check its installed chip.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.manifest: The cargo manifest does not match the original rocket.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.packing: The machine could not secure all cabin blocks.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.occupied: The reserved cabin area is occupied.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.restore: A cabin block could not be restored from its saved state.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.inspect: The transfer stopped. The ship's saved data is retained.
shipyard.starbridge.notice.disk: The ship could not be saved to disk. Ask the server owner to free space before retrying.
shipyard.starbridge.status.power: Connect power to the original assembler to continue.
shipyard.starbridge.status.scanning: The original machine is scanning the ship.
shipyard.starbridge.carry_fuel: Hold a propellant bucket to refuel
shipyard.starbridge.locate_hint: Open the sample rocket at the deck containing the highlighted part.
